name: Keyword Stuffing Attack in Dry Zone (Adversarial Rejection)
description: 12 coordinated reports repeating the keyword 'flood' and 'catastrophic dam collapse' during a bone-dry period with 0.0mm precipitation and zero GDACS/ReliefWeb alerts. Directly exposes and defeats Aegis's circular keyword fact-checker.
